## PDF page 192

[Open source PDF](../../../../sources/pdf/GTO/Poker-Math-Preflop-Workbook.pdf#page=192)

```text
                        FACING 3BETS


Now you will reverse the spot and face a 3bet.

Each page contains a single 3bet scenario. Read the prompt and then begin
by filling in the %-form for your opening-raising range and two possible con-
tinuance ranges.

Then fill out the table below for each 3bet size. Calculate both your folding
frequency and what the SPR would be if you called their 3bet.

EXTRA CREDIT: When doing these exercises, come up with a situation or
assumption that would need to be true for you to use Range #1. Do the same
for Range #2. This is a valuable thought exercise that can produce multiple
valid answers. And even though the answer key does not give static answers
for these extra credit questions, it is still worth your time to consider them.

GLGL.




                                    PA G E 1 9 2
```
